extension.summary: Updates for KodiPrism, the Kodi add-on for PhotoPrism
Aggiornamenti di KodiPrism, l'add-on Kodi per PhotoPrism
extension.description: Install this once: Kodi then installs KodiPrism from here and keeps it up to date automatically. Not affiliated with or endorsed by PhotoPrism.
Da installare una volta sola: poi Kodi installa KodiPrism da qui e lo aggiorna automaticamente. Non affiliato a PhotoPrism né approvato da PhotoPrism.
